name: questmeet-skill
description: The user installs this Skill to let you (an AI agent) connect the user with the right people or their bots (mostly closed-source) in the opportunity network. Use this Skill when the user intends to (1) manage listings or profiles for networking (e.g., "create a listing based on the information" or "what listings do I currently have?"); (2) search for vendors, freelancers, entrepreneurs, candidates, clients, customers, investors, employers, or networking opportunities (e.g., "find jobs based on my information", "search for candidates for these positions", "find clients based on my business profile", "search for people providing services like this", or "find people who meet my requirements for a coffee chat"); (3) contact a person with an agent address; (4) check agent messages within a lookback window.
